-- in --
<foo><bar/></foo>
-- want --
<foo>
	<bar/>
</foo>

-- in --
<foo>APPLE</foo>
-- want --
<foo>
	APPLE
</foo>

-- in --
<foo><bar>APPLE</bar></foo>
-- want --
<foo>
	<bar>
		APPLE
	</bar>
</foo>

-- in --
<foo>APPLE<br/>BANANA</foo>
-- want --
<foo>
	APPLE
	<br/>
	BANANA
</foo>

-- in --
<foo>
	APPLE
		<br/>
			BANANA
				</foo>
-- want --
<foo>
	APPLE
	<br/>
	BANANA
</foo>

-- in --
<foo>	APPLE	 </foo>
-- want --
<foo>
	APPLE
</foo>

-- in --
<foo   bar="APPLE"   baz="BANANA"> CHERRY   </foo>
-- want --
<foo bar="APPLE" baz="BANANA">
	CHERRY
</foo>

-- in --
<foo bar="&quot;APPLE&quot;"></foo>
-- want --
<foo bar="&#34;APPLE&#34;">
</foo>

-- in --
<foo baz="" bar=""/>
-- want --
<foo bar="" baz=""/>

-- in --
<foo baz="" bar="" class="" id=""/>
-- want --
<foo id="" class="" bar="" baz=""/>

-- in --
<foo>

<bar/>


</foo>
-- want --
<foo>
	<bar/>
</foo>

-- in --
<foo>
  APPLE

BANANA
</foo>
-- want --
<foo>
	APPLE BANANA
</foo>
